title: Optimal scaling laws in learning hierarchical multi-index models
abstract: arXiv:2602.05846v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this work, we provide a sharp theory of scaling laws for two-layer neural networks trained on a class of hierarchical multi-index targets, in a genuinely representation-limited regime. We derive exact information-theoretic scaling laws for subspace recovery and prediction error, revealing how the hierarchical features of the target are sequentially learned through a cascade of phase transitions. We further show that these optimal rates are achieved by a simple, target-agnostic spectral estimator, which can be interpreted as the small learning-rate limit of gradient descent on the first-layer weights. Once an adapted representation is identified, the readout can be learned statistically optimally, using an efficient procedure. As a consequence, we provide a unified and rigorous explanation of scaling laws, plateau phenomena, and spectral structure in shallow neural networks trained on such hierarchical targets.

translated_title: 学习层次化多指标模型中的最优标度律
translated_abstract: 在本工作中，我们为一类在层次化多指标目标上训练的两层神经网络，在真正受表示能力限制的情形下，提供了一个精确的标度律理论。我们推导出了子空间恢复和预测误差的精确信息论标度律，揭示了目标的层次化特征如何通过一系列相变的级联被依次学习。我们进一步证明，这些最优速率可以由一个简单的、与目标无关的谱估计器实现，该估计器可被解释为对第一层权重进行梯度下降时小学习率极限下的结果。一旦识别出合适的表示，读出层就可以通过高效的过程以统计最优的方式被学习。由此，我们为在此类层次化目标上训练的浅层神经网络中的标度律、平台现象和谱结构提供了一个统一而严格的解释。
tldr: 该论文为两层神经网络学习层次化多指标目标建立了精确的信息论标度律理论，证明层次特征通过级联相变被依次恢复且简单的谱估计器即可达到最优速率，从而统一解释了浅层神经网络的标度律、平台现象与谱结构。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes sharp information-theoretic scaling laws for two-layer neural networks learning hierarchical multi-index targets, showing that hierarchical features are sequentially recovered through a cascade of phase transitions and that a simple target-agnostic spectral estimator achieves optimal rates, thereby unifying scaling laws, plateau phenomena, and spectral structure in shallow networks.
